evidence.text: ai/tools/imported_services.py traces each imported-service charge (explicit supplier_residence=non_resident or TAX-024 vat_status=treatment_unverified marker) through contract -> invoice -> payment (+declared withholding) -> declared VAT/withholding treatment with Decimal-only amounts; gaps vs discrepancies are separated and unresolved_trail/unresolved_trail_amount flag the trail. ai/workflows/imported_services_playbook.py wraps it as a case-scoped TAX-022 tool plus review -> propose_evidence_request LangGraph nodes. SYN-004: INV-SYN-004-02 contract linked, payment reconciled (LSL 50000.00), VAT and withholding treatment not declared -> unresolved trail LSL 50000.00. Other four scenarios: no imported charges, no finding.

SYN-004 produces an advisory targeted_evidence_request with three neutral taxpayer questions (vat_treatment, withholding, service_performance) each citing CTR-SYN-004-02 and INV-SYN-004-02, status draft_requires_officer_approval; statutory_treatment.status=unverified_pending_expert_review, legal_conclusion/enforcement_conclusion/decision null; none of the TAX-024 expected non-findings emitted. Through the TAX-052 gate the finding is unverified_route and a proven_abuse action is blocked. Tests: .venv-ai pytest tests/ai 99 passed (12 new pure + 7 new graph: tenant isolation, fail-closed malformed money without leaking content, replay without duplicates, step budget, one-cent shortfall, Decimal sums, charge budget). ai.smoke passed; scripts/quality.py Python ruff/mypy pass.

Tests and evidence recorded on task/TAX-050 (criteria 1-2). Branch refreshed from main and pushed explicitly; human-review PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/128 opened with checks and Windows-only environment exceptions documented. Agent will not merge.
